Kim Allan is an actor was known for programs such as Sony Starz 'Outlander' (2015), Harlen Coben's 'The Five' for Sky 1 (2016) and Channel 4 comedy series 'Scrotal Recall' (2014). Also BAFTA nominated short film 'Black Night Broken, White Morning Woken' (2014). Kim is also known for the CBeebies series 'Teacup Travels' (2015).
